items.title: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Backs New Cancer Device And Leads $100 Million Depression Bet
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) agreed to invest in Francis Medical to help advance its Vanquish device for prostate cancer treatment. The group also led a US$100 million funding round in Delix Therapeutics to back clinical development of psychedelic inspired depression medicines. Both deals extend Johnson & Johnson’s reach into minimally invasive oncology tools and new psychiatric treatment approaches beyond its existing portfolio.
